questions.question:
**Direction: The following sentence has been divided into four segments. Select the segment that contains a grammatical error from the given options.**

I am going / to home / soon after the / programme gets over.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'to home.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in Part (to home) of the sentence.
 
• **Going to** is not a tense.
 
• It is a special structure that we use to talk about the future.
 
• **"Home"** is not a proper noun and it is an adverb of location.
 
• **"To"** needs to be omitted.
 
• *​*Therefore, the use of 'to home' in the sentence should be replaced with 'home' to make it grammatically correct.
 
• *​*Correct sentence__: *I am going home soon after the programme gets over.*

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 

 

 *

__
 
• We can use not … ever instead of never, but never is much more common.

 
 
• Example: *She has never been a friend of ours.*
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** 

 

 
• त्रुटि वाक्य के Part (to home) में निहित है।
 
• Going to, tense नहीं है।
 
• यह एक विशेष संरचना है जिसका उपयोग हम भविष्य के बारे में बात करने के लिए करते हैं।
 
• "Home" एक proper noun नहीं है और यह adverb of location है।
 
• "To" को छोड़ना होगा।
 
• इसलिए, वाक्य के 'to home' का उपयोग 'home' के साथ प्रतिस्थापित किया जाना चाहिए, इसे व्याकरणिक रूप से सही बनाने के लिए।

questions.question:
**Direction: Given below are four jumbled sentences. Out of the given options, select the one that gives their correct order.**

A. I sat patiently through them knowing they were not for me.

B. The headmaster read the list of qualities this year’s best student award had - most giving, contributed most to society, and so on.

C. At my high school graduation, the awards were being presented for achievement, contribution to the school, the community, scholarship, and more.

D. But when I heard my name called, I began to cry as I could not believe that I was actually chosen for the award.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'CABD.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• While arranging the parts of the passage given in options, we have to find some grammatical or contextual connections between them__, so let’s find out. 

 __
 
• The opener will be **C** as it introduces the context of the paragraph.
 
• After this, A will come as it adds information about the subject.
 
• After this, B will come as it is talking about the list of qualities read by the headmaster.
 
• D follows B as D talks about how the subject got chosen for the award.
 
• The last sentence will be D as it is providing a conclusion to the context.
 
 
 
• ​​The correct sequence__:​

C. At my high school graduation, the awards were being presented for achievement, contribution to the school, the community, scholarship, and more.

A. I sat patiently through them knowing they were not for me.

B. The headmaster read the list of qualities this year’s best student award had - most giving, contributed most to society, and so on.

D. But when I heard my name called, I began to cry as I could not believe that I was actually chosen for the award.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 

__
 
• Steps for solving Para Jumbles:
 
 
• Clues include pronouns, like he, she, it, this, that, these, those; adverbs like formally, really; article a, an and the; definers like actually, finally, another; connectors like but, yet, both, also and neither nor, or, however, nevertheless.
 
• Now, with the help of clues, try to find out qualifier and qualified sentences, so that we can make pairs of qualified and qualifier sentences to eliminate the wrong choices given in the question.
 
• After making pairs, start eliminating the wrong choices or options given in the question.
 
• In case there is more than one choice, try to follow the sequence of sentences according to the occurrence of the events.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** 

 
• विकल्पों में दिए गए गद्यांश के भागों को व्यवस्थित करते समय, हमें उनके बीच कुछ व्याकरणिक या प्रासंगिक संबंध खोजने होंगे, तो आइए जानें।
 
 
• Opener, C होगा क्योंकि यह पैराग्राफ के संदर्भ का परिचय देता है।
 
• इसके बाद, Aआएगा क्योंकि यह विषय के बारे में जानकारी जोड़ता है।
 
• इसके बाद, B आएगा क्योंकि यह प्रधानाध्यापक द्वारा पढ़े गए गुणों की सूची के बारे में बात कर रहा है।

 D, B का अनुसरण करता है क्योंकि D इस बारे में बात करता है कि पुरस्कार के लिए विषय कैसे चुना गया।
 
• अंतिम वाक्य D होगा क्योंकि यह संदर्भ को निष्कर्ष प्रदान कर रहा है।

questions.question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution required'.**

This is the student __which won__ the first prize in the recitation.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'who won.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The relative pronoun 'which' is used for animals in general or non-living things.

 
 
• **Example:** *Raghav** bought the top hybrid car, which will help him save on gas.*
 
 
 
• “Who” is a subjective pronoun and “Whom” is an objective pronoun.
 
• “Who” is always subject to a verb, and “whom” is always working as an object in a sentence. 
 
• If you can replace the word with “he” or "she,” use who.
 
• If you can replace it with “him” or “her,” use whom.
 
• Examples: 
 
 
• *Who would like to go on vacation?*
 
• *I do not know with whom I will go to the prom.*
 
 
 
• ***​*Whose** is a possessive pronoun.
 
• Use it when you're asking (or telling) to whom something belongs.
 
 
• **Example**:* **Whose** chair is this?*
 
 
 
• *​*Therefore, the use of 'which' in the sentence should be replaced with 'who' to make it grammatically correct.
 
• *​​*Correct sentence__: *This is the student **who** won the first prize in the recitation.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

__
 
• A pronoun is “any member of a small class of words found in many languages that are used as replacements or substitutes for nouns and noun phrases, and that have a very general reference,” such as I, you, he, this, it, who, what.
 
• Types:
 
 
• Personal pronouns
 
• Possessive pronouns
 
• Relative pronouns
 
• Reflexive pronouns
 
• Intensive pronouns
 
• Indefinite pronouns
 
• Demonstrative pronouns
 
• Interrogative pronouns
 
• Reciprocal pronouns
 
• Distributive pronouns
 
 

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** *

 
• Relative pronoun 'which' का प्रयोग सामान्यतया जानवरों या चीजों के लिए किया जाता है।

 
 
• **Example:** *Raghav** bought the top hybrid car, which will help him save on gas.*
 
 
 
• “Who” एक subjective pronoun है और “Whom” एक objective pronoun है।
 
• “Who” हमेशा एक verb के अधीन होता है, और “Whom” हमेशा एक वाक्य में एक object के रूप में कार्य करता है।
 
• यदि आप शब्द को 'he' या 'she' से बदल सकते हैं, तो who का उपयोग करें।
 
• यदि आप इसे “him” या “her” से बदल सकते हैं, तो whom उपयोग करें।​
 
• Examples: 
 
 
• *Who would like to go on vacation?*
 
• *I do not know with whom I will go to the prom.*
 
 
 
• **Whose, **possessive pronoun है।
 
• इसका उपयोग तब करें जब आप पूछ रहे हों (या बता रहे हैं) कि कुछ किसका है।
 
 
• Example:* Whose chair is this?*
 
 
 
• इसलिए, वाक्य में 'which' का उपयोग 'who' के साथ प्रतिस्थापित किया जाना चाहिए, इसे व्याकरणिक रूप से सही बनाने के लिए।
 
• इसलिए, सही उत्तर 'who it belonged' है।​
